STRIKE.name: Strike
STRIKE.text: Damage equal to the dice it reads.

flawless.text: Also hits the creature behind the target.

CLEAVE.name: Cleave
CLEAVE.text: Damage twice the pair's value, half of it to the creatures beside the target.

flawless.text: The neighbours take the full blow.

CRUSH.name: Crush
CRUSH.text: Damage three times the matched value.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
BARRAGE.text: One hit of 4 for every die in the straight.

flawless.text: The hits spread across every creature.

OVERKILL.name: Overkill
OVERKILL.text: Damage equal to your whole total.

flawless.text: Half the total again to the creature behind.

SPALL.name: Spall
SPALL.text: Damage twice the sum of your two lowest dice.

flawless.text: Each low die also leaves a poison.

FURY.name: Fury
FURY.text: 4 damage for every die you rerolled this turn.

GUARD.name: Guard
GUARD.text: Block equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Half as much again to every ally.

BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.text: Block equal to everything your dice left on the table.

flawless.text: The whole party stands behind it.

AEGIS.name: Aegis
AEGIS.text: Block to every ally equal to the top of the straight.

BASTION.name: Bastion
BASTION.text: Block to every ally equal to both values of the house.

flawless.text: The party shrugs off two afflictions each.

ANCHOR.name: Anchor
ANCHOR.text: 2 block for every die you did not reroll.

RIPOSTE.name: Riposte
RIPOSTE.text: Damage equal to the block you lost since your last turn.

MEND.name: Mend
MEND.text: Heal equal to the dice it reads.

flawless.text: Half of it again as block.

GRAFT.name: Graft
GRAFT.text: Heal equal to both pair values.

BLOOM.name: Bloom
BLOOM.text: Heal every ally 1 for each odd die.

RENEWAL.name: Renewal
RENEWAL.text: Heal the top of the straight and cleanse one affliction.

LIFELINE.name: Lifeline
LIFELINE.text: Once a fight, revive a fallen ally with three times the matched value. With nobody down, heal the party half of that.

flawless.text: The revived ally also gains block equal to the value.

SAP.name: Sap
SAP.text: Damage equal to the healing you did this turn.

flawless.text: And the party is healed half of it.

VENOM.name: Venom
VENOM.text: Poison equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: And half the value in damage.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.text: The target takes 25% more from every gem after this one this turn.

SHATTER.name: Shatter
SHATTER.text: Strip block worth three times the matched value, then damage the value.

BIND.name: Bind
BIND.text: The target loses one die next turn.

DREAD.name: Dread
DREAD.text: The target's next move is weakened a step.

TITHE.name: Tithe
TITHE.text: Ore equal to the pair's value.

JACKPOT.name: Jackpot
JACKPOT.text: Ore equal to the matched value times the dice matched. Five of a kind pays ten times.

LUCKY_SEVEN.name: Lucky Seven
LUCKY_SEVEN.text: 7 damage and 7 ore for every seven.

WAGER.name: Wager
WAGER.text: 5 ore, and damage equal to everything your dice left on the table.

WINDFALL.name: Windfall
WINDFALL.text: Stones found in this fight are 10% better.

DOUBLE_DOWN.name: Double Down
DOUBLE_DOWN.text: Flip a coin: the next gem is doubled, or does nothing.

PROSPECT.name: Prospect
PROSPECT.text: Gain a Sparkle. At five Sparkles the next stone you find is a grade better.

GLIMMER.name: Glimmer
GLIMMER.text: Raise your lowest die for every gem after this one.

flawless.text: Raise it all the way to your highest.

REFRACT.name: Refract
REFRACT.text: Add a phantom die copying your highest for every gem after this one.

POLISH.name: Polish
POLISH.text: Set one die to match another, making a pair, for every gem after this one.

MIRROR.name: Mirror
MIRROR.text: Flip your lowest die to the other side of its range for every gem after this one.

FACET.name: Facet
FACET.text: The next gem is judged one Cut step better.

ECHO.name: Echo
ECHO.text: Repeat the previous gem at half strength.

NEEDLE.name: Needle
NEEDLE.text: +1 damage for every die this gem reads.

EMBERLINE.name: Emberline
EMBERLINE.text: 1 poison to the target when this fires.

GLINT.name: Glint
GLINT.text: Ore equal to the dice matched when this fires.

DUSTING.name: Dusting
DUSTING.text: Block equal to the dice matched when this fires.

VEIL.name: Veil
VEIL.text: This gem reads your lowest die as if it were your highest.

CATS_EYE.name: Cat's Eye
CATS_EYE.text: This gem reads every 1 as wild.

GRAINING.name: Graining
GRAINING.text: This gem counts held dice twice in sets.

ZONING_RED.name: Red Zoning
ZONING_RED.text: Counts as Red as well as its own colour.

ZONING_BLUE.name: Blue Zoning
ZONING_BLUE.text: Counts as Blue as well as its own colour.

ZONING_GREEN.name: Green Zoning
ZONING_GREEN.text: Counts as Green as well as its own colour.

ZONING_VIOLET.name: Violet Zoning
ZONING_VIOLET.text: Counts as Violet as well as its own colour.

ZONING_GOLD.name: Gold Zoning
ZONING_GOLD.text: Counts as Gold as well as its own colour.

ZONING_WHITE.name: White Zoning
ZONING_WHITE.text: Counts as White as well as its own colour.

FEATHER.name: Feather
FEATHER.text: The next gem in the rail is judged one Cut step better.

TWINNING_WISP.name: Twinning Wisp
TWINNING_WISP.text: Fires again if the gem before it fired.

FINGERPRINT.name: Fingerprint
FINGERPRINT.text: Carries one inclusion of the gem before it.

HALO.name: Halo
HALO.text: Neighbouring gems of this colour gain a carat.

FRACTURE.name: Fracture
FRACTURE.text: Twice the strength, but it fizzles if any die shows a 1.

BRUISE.name: Bruise
BRUISE.text: Half again the strength; you lose 2 HP when it fires.

KNOT.name: Knot
KNOT.text: +2 carats, but it cannot leave its socket during a run.

CAVITY.name: Cavity
CAVITY.text: Its carats count double, but its cut counts as Poor.

FLUORESCENCE.name: Fluorescence
FLUORESCENCE.text: +1 carat for every depth below 10 while underground.

ALEXANDRITE.name: Alexandrite
ALEXANDRITE.text: Takes the colour of whatever socket it sits in.

PHIAL.name: The Phial
PHIAL.text: Rue's own die. It cannot roll high, so every face of it is low.

GAMBLERS_D6.name: Gambler's Die
GAMBLERS_D6.text: A six-sider whose six is a seven. Florin's dice.

ALWAYS_HELD.name: Set
ALWAYS_HELD.text: Counts as held even when rerolled.

TWIN.name: Twin
TWIN.text: Counts as two dice in every set.

ARDOR.name: Ardor
ARDOR.title: the Knight
ARDOR.text: The wall. Locks in early, heals for patience, and turns a lucky triple into a hammer.

passive.name: Second Wind
passive.text: Heal 3 for each unused reroll when your rail begins.

birthstone.name: Rally
birthstone.text: Almandine garnet in a shield cut. Sets of matching dice rally the Knight.
birthstone.face: Jaw set, eyes narrowed, a slow nod.

tiers.name: File
tiers.text: Three of a kind: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: Phalanx
tiers.text: Four of a kind: cleanse yourself and stun the target.

tiers.name: Legion
tiers.text: Five of a kind: deal five times Resonance, five times.

VESPER.name: Vesper
VESPER.title: the Rogue
VESPER.text: The assassin's gamble. Four tiny knives and one enormous die.

passive.name: Riposte
passive.text: Gain Resonance block for every hit one of your gems lands.

birthstone.name: Thousand Cuts
birthstone.text: Black opal in a needle-thin marquise: a dark body and a thousand pinprick flashes.
birthstone.face: A thin smile, eyes on the target.

tiers.name: Thousand Cuts
tiers.text: Five different values, the top die outrolling the other four combined: deal Resonance damage once for every point on your highest die.

CADENCE.name: Cadence
CADENCE.title: the Wizard
CADENCE.text: The combo player. Runs of numbers, and the turn that plays twice.

birthstone.name: Encore
birthstone.text: Ametrine, violet fading to gold, in a step cut: a staircase of facets.
birthstone.face: Eyes closed, one hand raised like a conductor.

tiers.name: Overture
tiers.text: A straight of four: deal four times Resonance to every creature.

tiers.name: Encore
tiers.text: A straight of five: every gem that fired plays again, Overture included, and Resonance keeps climbing.

RUE.name: Rue
RUE.title: the Apothecary
RUE.text: The low roller. Wants ones. Everything the others dread, Rue drinks.

passive.name: Leech
passive.text: Heal Resonance whenever poison damages a creature.

birthstone.name: Bitter Draught
birthstone.text: Dark tourmaline briolette, a faceted teardrop, murky green-black with a trapped bubble.
birthstone.face: A wry grimace, as if tasting it.

tiers.name: Tincture
tiers.text: Four or more low dice: poison the target for Resonance.

tiers.name: Draught
tiers.text: All five low: every poison on every creature ticks at once.

tiers.name: Dregs
tiers.text: All five showing 1: every poison ticks Resonance times.

PUCK.name: Puck
PUCK.title: the Harlequin
PUCK.text: Two faces. You choose which one the enemy sees, every turn.

passive.name: Sleight
passive.text: Once a turn, flip one die to the other side of its range for free.

birthstone.name: Motley
birthstone.text: Watermelon tourmaline, pink one half and green the other, in a checkerboard cut.
birthstone.face: One eye winking, mouth half grin, half frown.

tiers.name: The Cruel Face
tiers.text: All five dice odd: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: The Kind Face
tiers.text: All five dice even: gain three times Resonance block.

tiers.name: Full Motley
tiers.text: All one parity and all different, like 2-4-6-8-10: both faces, doubled, and the target is stunned.

FLORIN.name: Florin
FLORIN.title: the Gambler
FLORIN.text: The six-socket high roller. Loaded dice, fool's gold, and a stone once in a hundred turns.

passive.name: Loaded
passive.text: Any die that lands on a 1 is rerolled once, free.

birthstone.name: High Roller
birthstone.text: A pyrite cube: fool's gold, which grows as a perfect die in the rock.

tiers.name: Ante
tiers.text: Each crown, a die on its top face: Resonance damage and Resonance ore.

tiers.name: Hot Streak
tiers.text: Three crowns: stones found in this fight are a grade better.

tiers.name: Royal Flush
tiers.text: Five crowns: a raw stone drops on the spot, Exquisite or better.

tiers.name: Bust
tiers.text: No crown showing: lose Resonance ore.

SILT_SLIME.name: Silt Slime
SILT_SLIME.text: Splits when struck hard. Dies to many small blows.

QUARTZ_GOLEM.name: Quartz Golem
QUARTZ_GOLEM.text: Gains block equal to your highest die each turn.

MAGPIE.name: Magpie
MAGPIE.text: Steals ore when it hits and drops it all when it dies.

LANTERN_MOTH.name: Lantern Moth
LANTERN_MOTH.text: Its light gives you a reroll and drains a little life for each one you use.

VEIN_WRAITH.name: Vein Wraith
VEIN_WRAITH.text: Poison cannot touch it. Straights cut it deep.

CLOUDER.name: Clouder
CLOUDER.text: Breathes a fog into one of your sockets until you strike it.

GLASS_WYRM.name: Glass Wyrm
GLASS_WYRM.text: Throws back damage from gems that fire at Resonance 0.

THE_FOREMAN.name: The Foreman
THE_FOREMAN.text: Warden of the eighth landing. Buries one of your sockets in rubble each turn.

THE_REGENT.name: The Mirror Regent
THE_REGENT.text: Warden of the sixteenth landing. Turns your last gem back on you.

THE_DRILL.name: The Drill
THE_DRILL.text: Warden of the twenty-fourth landing. On odd turns it rolls your dice for you.

QUARRY.name: The Quarry
QUARRY.text: Old galleries under the workshop. Ticks and slimes near the top, golems and wyrms below.

CUTTERS_WHEEL.name: The Cutter's Wheel
CUTTERS_WHEEL.text: An old wheel, still spinning. A stone laid against it might come away truer, or in pieces.

choices.label: Re-cut a stone
choices.text: Cut moves up one step 60%, down one step 30%, shatters 10%.

ACID_BATH.name: Acid Bath
ACID_BATH.text: A pool that eats what is frozen inside a stone.

choices.label: Dissolve an inclusion
choices.text: Choose a stone and one inclusion. It is gone.

choices.label: Bathe the haul
choices.text: Every raw stone you carry shows its inclusions.

CRUCIBLE.name: The Crucible
CRUCIBLE.text: Two stones go in. One comes out.

choices.label: Fuse two stones
choices.text: Keep one stone's skill. Its carats become the sum of both, up to 20. Each inclusion of either survives 50%.

GEODE.name: Geode
GEODE.text: A round grey rock, heavier than it looks.

choices.label: Crack it open
choices.text: Three small stones 45%, one heavy stone 35%, dust 20%.

GRINDER.name: The Grinder
GRINDER.text: A bench grinder and a set of engraving needles.

choices.label: Grind a face off a die
choices.text: Choose a die and a face. The face is replaced by its neighbour.

choices.label: Engrave a die
choices.text: Choose a die and an engraving. It takes 40%, cracks the die's best face 10%, or nothing.

OLD_PROSPECTOR.name: The Old Prospector
OLD_PROSPECTOR.text: He wants one of your raw stones and offers one of his, a carat heavier. He will not let you look.

choices.label: Trade a stone
choices.text: Give a raw stone. Receive a raw stone one carat heavier.

SHRINE.name: Shrine of the Pattern
SHRINE.text: Dice are carved into the wall, all showing the same thing.

choices.label: Choose a pattern
choices.text: For the rest of this run, gems that fire on that pattern gain a carat.

IDOL.name: The Idol
IDOL.text: A stone the size of a fist sits in its eye. It is cracked all through.

choices.label: Take the eye
choices.text: A stone of at least 16 carats, appraised, Veined with two Fractures.

ECHO_CHAMBER.name: Echo Chamber
ECHO_CHAMBER.text: Whatever is inside one stone rings in another.

choices.label: Copy an inclusion
choices.text: Choose an inclusion on one stone and another stone with room for it.

DICE_BOWL.name: The Dice Bowl
DICE_BOWL.text: A bowl of dice left by whoever came before.

choices.label: Swap a die
choices.text: Drop one of your dice in and draw another of the same shape.

COLLECTOR.name: The Collector
COLLECTOR.text: She pays three times what a stone is worth, and keeps it forever.

choices.label: Sell a stone
choices.text: Triple its value in ore. The stone is gone.

LOUPE_CABINET.name: Loupe Cabinet
LOUPE_CABINET.text: A cabinet of lenses, most of them cracked.

FIELD_MEDIC.name: Field Medic
FIELD_MEDIC.text: A miner with a kit and a price.

choices.label: Be treated
choices.text: Recover a quarter of your HP.

VUG.name: The Vug
VUG.text: A pocket in the rock, walls glittering. The air is bad.

choices.label: Squeeze in
choices.text: A rich vein, but every strike costs 3 HP.
